events.title: Grounded spec built
events.reasoning: The PRD specifies that the phone field should accept any 10‑digit number, but the backend validation only checks length, not that the characters are digits, creating a spec‑vs‑product gap. This discrepancy can be verified by submitting a 10‑character string containing non‑numeric symbols and confirming the request succeeds. Testing this edge case will ensure the product aligns with the documented requirement.

deltas.prdSays: Accept any 10-digit number; reject malformed input politely (PRD §4.3, §5).
deltas.productDoes: The API checks phone LENGTH (rejects 9 or 11 digits) but NOT that characters are digits — it accepts a 10-char value containing letters. The frontend enforces digits-only, so the API is more lenient than the UI.
